title: Spyglass: Unleash Your Insights
summary: We are thrilled to announce that Spyglass has officially launched, providing powerful new capabilities to help you gain deeper insights and make informed decisions.

title: Powerful File Management in Your Editor
summary: Effortlessly manage and display your embedded files with new controls, upload options, and customizable views directly within the editor.

title: Introducing Our Public Product Roadmap
summary: Discover our new public roadmap, offering complete transparency into recently launched features, upcoming developments, and long-term plans for Noeko.

title: Effortless Checkboxes
summary: Enjoy a more intuitive and visually appealing experience with redesigned checkboxes that are easier to click, drag, and interact with.

title: Enhanced Team Collaboration
summary: Experience seamless teamwork with new enhancements that make real-time collaboration smoother and more intuitive for everyone.

title: Empowered Sharing and Discovery
summary: Users can now effortlessly discover and engage with all shared ideas and quests from their network, fostering richer collaboration.

title: Global Language Support
summary: Experience Noeko in more languages as we introduce comprehensive international language support to connect users worldwide.

title: Noeko is Now Open Source!
summary: Noeko's codebase is now open source, empowering our community with unprecedented control, direct involvement, and complete transparency in its future development.

title: Unlock Deeper Insights with Your Enhanced Constellation View
summary: Transform your Constellation View into a powerful workflow starter and exploration tool with new filtering options by tags and time, plus the ability to easily manage shared items and connections.

title: Refined Search and Custom Collections
summary: Unlock precise insights into your knowledge with powerful new filtering and sorting options, allowing you to save and instantly revisit custom collections of information.

title: Transform Your Notes with Dynamic Content Displays
summary: Unlock a more intuitive way to organize your thoughts with dynamic content displays that allow you to seamlessly preview and interact with connected information directly within your notes.

title: Noeko Self-Hosting & Flexible Plans
summary: Empower your team with the freedom to deploy Noeko on your own infrastructure, coupled with new flexible paid plans designed to meet your specific needs.

title: Vibrant New Themes & Polished Classics
summary: We're refreshing our current themes and introducing a collection of stunning new visual styles to make your experience even more beautiful.

title: Enhanced Time-Aware Greetings
summary: Experience a truly personalized welcome with greetings that now precisely reflect the actual time of day, enhancing your interaction from the moment you log in.

title: Streamlined Tag Management
summary: Effortlessly manage your tagged content by taking direct action on items—including removal—straight from any tag list, saving you valuable time.

title: Unlock More Content Sources
summary: Seamlessly bring your essential knowledge from a wider variety of content types, including videos, web pages, and text, directly into your workflow.
